why: I checked all four must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one. (1) Verifier Check 3 runs `ok1.jsonl missing.jsonl bad.jsonl` together. Its PASS rule requires "missing exit=2, stderr mentions missing.jsonl, and stdout still includes the `<dir>/bad.jsonl:1: ` line". (2) Check 4 runs `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` and passes only if the diff is empty, so it compares the head against the base. (3) Builder step 3 says to "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" with the multi-file usage, stdin via `-` and the exit codes. (4) Check 6 reads GitHub with `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid,state` and `gh pr checks`. It requires the body to contain "Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/104" and "the `test` workflow check at the head commit is green".
